name: Printify
summary: Global print-on-demand network. Create custom products and automate your e-commerce fulfillment without holding inventory.
best_for: creators and stores testing print-on-demand with no upfront cost, upgrading to Premium once volume justifies it
skip_if: you sell only a handful of items a month — the free plan is right, and Premium's fee outweighs the discount
honest_knock: Printify makes nothing until you sell — the Premium fee only pays off past a break-even order volume, and because it's a middleman marketplace, print quality and shipping vary by the provider you pick. Order samples first.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month, or from $24.99/mo billed yearly
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-07 and again 2026-10-01) A free plan at $0 a month -- you pay only the product base cost plus shipping per order -- and Premium from $39 a month, or from $24.99 a month billed yearly, which the page states as 36% off. Premium's discount is printed as two separate lines: up to 33% off new products and up to 20% off all products. Enterprise is custom. The break-even is arithmetic rather than opinion: at roughly $8.77 of fulfilment cost on a typical item -- the figure the page's own profit calculator uses -- Premium pays for itself somewhere between 14 items a month at the 33% ceiling and 23 at the 20% floor, and below that the free plan is genuinely the cheaper choice.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 30 October 2026 on a free account: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We made one unpublished mug design with our own test image, edited its listing and looked for ways to export the product or its mockups.
findings: The account opened in an AI wizard that had already made five designs, all selected 'to publish'. Leaving it warns that you lose this 'reserved collection'.
Catalog prices show two numbers, for example 'From USD 6.40' and 'From USD 4.71 with Printify Premium'. No card was asked.
Our 1000 × 720 test image got a 'Medium resolution (187 DPI)' warning on the mug.
Opening the product brought a pop-up for AI-optimised listings, which we declined. The listing was filled in for us anyway: 40 mockups, 16 tags and a suggested price of $11.99-$16.99.
The product stayed unpublished; publishing needs a connected store. The product menu has no export, and the mockup download buttons gave us no file.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
